text: I think you'll enjoy this recipe for Kona Inn Banana Bread. Given your preference for recipes featuring bread flour and yeast, I'm surprised to see that this recipe uses all-purpose flour, but the addition of bananas and the relatively short preparation time might make it an appealing exception. Additionally, the nutrition facts suggest a high calorie count, which aligns with your observed pattern of possibly preferring lighter eating. I'm recommending this recipe to see how you adapt it to your taste, and perhaps make some adjustments to reduce the calorie and sodium content.
